title: Polynomial lower bounds for nonzero algebraic-integer linear combinations of E-function values over a fixed number field at algebraic points
author: Stéphane Fischler; Tanguy Rivoal
work: Values of $E$-functions are not Liouville numbers
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 11 (2024), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.249
difficulty_reason: Shidlovskii's quoted quantitative theorem applies to rational-coefficient E-functions and cannot simply be applied to the given number-field vector or a possibly singular evaluation point. The authors remove singularities and dependencies, then construct a Galois product whose normal-basis rational components form a closed rational differential system and whose evaluated combination has integer coefficients. Tracking the nonzero product, coefficient houses and non-Galois coset action completes a source-specific descent construction beyond merely applying a field norm inequality.
